title: CAD Software Action Learning — Per-Software Drawing Intelligence
brief: Teach AGI HOW to draw in each CAD software (CadQuery / FreeCAD / Fusion360 / Mastercam / Inventor / hyperMILL / SolidCAM). Action-sequence learning with click-by-click reproduction, scripting API mastery, and software-specific idiom absorption. Closes the gap between 'knowing what to draw' (MS0) and 'knowing how to draw it in software X'.

must_include: FreeCAD Python API reference (Part, PartDesign, Sketcher, Draft workbenches)

smart_config.role: Fusion360 Expert + Autodesk Forge API Specialist

must_include: JM Die: 3,713 real Mastercam .mcx-8 files as corpus

smart_config.role: Inventor iLogic Expert + SolidCAM Integration Specialist
must_include: PRISM existing CAMDeepLearningEngine consolidation of 18 CAM systems

session_plan.title: Cross-Software Translator + Action Validator + Dispatcher Wiring

must_include: All 7 software action APIs from prior sessions

units.title: FreeCADActionExecutorEngine — Python-driven headless FreeCAD automation
units.intent: Execute any CAD operation in FreeCAD via Python API. Transform neural token sequence (from MS0) → live FreeCAD Python commands → actual .FCStd file. Reproduce every operation a human would do: open workbench, create sketch, add constraints, pad/pocket, pattern, boolean.

loops.loop_1_build: Wrap FreeCAD Python API. 40+ action primitives (newSketch, addLine, addConstraint, pad, pocket, revolve, mirror, pattern, fillet, chamfer, boolean, loft, sweep). Session sandbox via python-shell subprocess. Token→action mapping.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Safety-physics agent + code-reviewer agent. Check: no arbitrary code execution, sandbox isolation, deterministic operation ordering, error recovery on FreeCAD crashes.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Fill missing actions. Cover Draft, Sheet Metal, Surface workbenches. Add topology reference resolution (edge/face names across rebuilds).
loops.loop_4_tie_up: JSDoc all 40+ action primitives. Write developer guide for adding new action types.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Execute 100 random JM Die part sketches → 95%+ produce valid .FCStd files identical to reference (within 0.001mm).
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If FreeCAD subprocess leaks > 100MB or hangs > 60s, abort and roll back.
exit_gate.rollback_procedure: git revert HEAD; remove FreeCAD python-shell dependency.

units.title: CadQueryActionExecutorEngine — DSL chain synthesis
units.intent: Generate and execute CadQuery Python DSL chains. Token sequence → Workplane().box().faces().chamfer() equivalent code → executable solid. Leverage CadQuery's selector language for robust topology references.

loops.loop_1_build: DSL chain builder. Selector synthesis ('>Z', '%CIRCLE', 'not >X'). STEP/STL export. OCP kernel leveraged directly.
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: CAD geometry validator + code-reviewer. Check: selector robustness across parametric variations, CSG operation correctness, export integrity.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Sketch primitives (sketch(), push(), rect()), assembly support (Assembly class), parametric workflows.
loops.loop_4_tie_up: JSDoc. Cross-reference CadQuery docs. Example library (100 common features).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generate 50 parametric families with 10 variations each — 500 models, 100% build success, 99%+ dimensional accuracy.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If selector failures exceed 5%, escalate to CAD team review.

units.title: FreeCADIdiomLearnerEngine — learn FreeCAD-specific conventions
units.intent: Every software has idioms. Learn FreeCAD conventions: using Sketcher workbench vs PartDesign, how to name bodies, which operations to prefer (pad vs extrude), ExternalGeometry usage patterns. Extracted from 500 reference .FCStd files.

loops.loop_1_build: Pattern miner on reference .FCStd corpus. Extract: naming conventions, workbench selection heuristics, operation ordering preferences. Idiom embedding (256-dim vector per idiom).
loops.loop_2_scrutinize: ML-reviewer + CAD-expert. Check: idiom extraction robustness, false pattern filtering, over-fitting to single author style.
loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Cross-author idiom diversity. Idiom composition rules. Anti-patterns (what NOT to do).

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: Generated FreeCAD models match reference idiom style 80%+ of time (judged by 3 FreeCAD experts blinded).
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If idiom extraction yields < 50 valid patterns, corpus insufficient — request more.

loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Fusion360 expert agent + code-reviewer. Check: timeline state integrity, BRep stability, API deprecation warnings.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 5 generative design runs produce manufacturable outcomes (no support structures beyond shop capability).

loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Error recovery on invalid rules, versioned rule migration.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 20 rule-driven parametric models, 100% rebuild success across 10 parameter variations each.
exit_gate.abort_criteria: If rule engine exhibits O(n^2) or worse evaluation cost, redesign.

loops.loop_2_scrutinize: Interop expert + QA. Check: volume conservation after translation, feature tree preservation where possible.

exit_gate.machinist_acceptance: 95%+ volume preservation across 100 round-trip tests. No manifold errors.

loops.loop_3_gap_fill: Parametric assembly validation. Drawing view alignment check.
